Hermes Agent by Nous Research, the self-improving open-source AI agent, running as a Telegram / Discord messaging gateway with persistent memory, skills and cron.

Set an LLM API key plus a bot token and allowed user IDs, then start the server. Other providers and platforms can be configured in .hermes/.env and .hermes/config.yaml.

https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent

variables.description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal. Leave blank to disable Discord.

variables.name: Discord Allowed Users
